agyos_skill.intent: Next.js App Router principles. Server Components, data fetching, routing patterns.
agyos_skill.instructions: > Principles for Next.js App Router development. ``` Does it need...? │ ├── useState, useEffect, event handlers │ └── Client Component ('use client') │ ├── Direct data fetching, no interactivity │ └── Server Component (default) │ └── Both? └── Split: Server parent + Client child ``` | Type | Use | |------|-----| | **Server** | Data fetching, layout, static content | | **Client** | Forms, buttons, interactive UI | | Pattern | Use | |---------|-----| | **Default** | Static (cached at build) | | **Revalidate** | ISR (time-based refresh) | | **No-store** | Dynamic (every request) | | Source | Pattern | |--------|---------| | Database | Server Component fetch |
